description: This file contains implementation of PHY library functions for Realtek Ethernet PHY devices, including delay functions, register access APIs, and power/loopback controls.

methods.name: void rtk_phylib_mdelay(uint32 msec)
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of milliseconds, using Linux or OSAL timing functions depending on compile-time flags.

methods.name: void rtk_phylib_udelay(uint32 usec)
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of microseconds, using Linux or OSAL timing functions depending on compile-time flags.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_mmd_write(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 mmd,uint32 reg,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint32 data)
methods.description: Performs an MMD write operation to PHY registers, with support for Linux and non-Linux environments.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_mmd_read(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 mmd,uint32 reg,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint32 * pData)
methods.description: Performs an MMD read operation from PHY registers, with support for Linux and non-Linux environments.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_power_normal(rtk_phydev * phydev)
methods.description: Sets PHY to normal power mode via MMD register.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_power_low(rtk_phydev * phydev)
methods.description: Sets PHY to low power mode via MMD register.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_pcs_loopback(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 enable)
methods.description: Enables or disables PCS loopback mode on the PHY.
